Daily Quiz.question: ১) Who is the earliest epic poet of English literature?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Caedmon is the first known poet or earliest epic poet of English literature. He is also called Father of English Sacred Song. He is the writer of Paraphrase.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ২) What is the Slogan of the Neo-Classical period?
Daily Quiz.exp:
'Art for Humanity's Sake' is the Slogan of Neo-Classical period and 'Art for Art's Sake' is the Slogan of Romantic Period.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Who wrote the poem 'The Definition of Love'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
The famous poems of Andrew Marvell are To His Coy Mistress, The Definition of Love, The Garden etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) Who is known as 'Epic Poet'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
John Milton is a writer of Caroline Age. He is called Epic Poet and also called 'A great master of verse in Puritan Period'. His famous Epics are Paradise Lost and Paradise Regained.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) Who is the writer of 'Pilgrim's Progress'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
John Bunyan is the powerful writer of Puritan Period. He is famous for his allegory. His famous writings are Pilgrim's Progress, The Holy War, The Life and Death of Mr. Badman.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) Who is known as 'Comedy of Manners'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
William Congreve was famous for Comedy of Manners. His famous plays: The Way of The World, Love for Love, The Double Dealer, The Old Bachelor etc. On the other hand All for Love is written by John Dryden.
Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) Who is the writer of 'Dunciad'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Alexander Pope is called Mock Heroic Poet. Famous epics of Alexander Pope is The Rape of the Lock. His famous works- An Essay on Criticism, The Dunciad, The Imitation of Horace, An Essay on Man, Letter to Gay.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) Who wrote the poem 'To Daffodils'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
The Greatest Cavalier poet is Robert Herrick. He is a famous poet of Caroline Period. His famous poet are To Daffodils, Delight in Disorder, The Night Piece of Julia, The Slitany to the Holy Spirit.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) 'Lycidas' is famous Elegy written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
'Lycidas' is famous Elegy by written John Milton. John Milton is called Epic Poet. He is also called 'A great master of verse in Puritan Period'. His famous epics are Paradise Lost and Paradise Regained.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) Who wrote the novel 'Amelia'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Henry Fielding regarded as 'Father of English Novel' and his famous Novels are Tom Jones, Amelia, Joseph Andrews, Jonathan Wilde, Top Secret.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) Who is the writer of 'The Vicar of Wakefield'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Oliver Goldsmith is an Irish novelist, playwright and poet. His famous works are The Citizen of the World, The Traveller, The Vicar of Wakefield, The Deserted Village, The good Natured Man, She Stoops to Conquer.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) The earliest prose of English literature is-
Daily Quiz.exp:
The Anglo-Saxon Chronicle is the earliest prose of English literature. It is compiled by King Alfred the Great. He is called Founder of English prose.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) Who is the 'University Wits'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Elizabethan Period এর একদল Young dramatist and pamphleteers (ক্ষুদ্র পুস্তিকা রচয়িতা) দেরকে University Wits বলা হয়। তাঁরা Oxford and Cambridge University এর Scholar/Witty students ছিলেন। তাঁরা অনেক বিখ্যাত নাটক রচনা ও মঞ্চস্থ করার মাধ্যমে খ্যাতি অর্জন করেছিলেন। University Wits ছিলেন মোট ৭ জন।
এঁরা হলেন- Christopher Marlowe, Thomas Kyd, Robert Greene, George Peele, Thomas Nashe, John Lyly and Thomas Lodge.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) Who is a 'Metaphysical poet'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
John Donne is a Metaphysical Poet. He is called the Poet of Love and Religious Poet.
His famous poems are The Good Morrow, The Flea, The Ecstasy, The Sun Rising, The Canonization, Twicknam Garden, For Whom The Bell Tolls etc.
Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) Who wrote the novel 'Robinson Cruse'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
'Robinson Cruse' is a Novel which is written by Daniel Defoe. His other famous novel is Captain Singleton.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) Who wrote the book 'Spirit of Nations'?
Daily Quiz.exp: Famous books of Voltaire- Spirit of Nations, Candide, Zaire, Essays on Morals etc.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) Who wrote the play 'Volpone'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Ben Jonson Comedies are known as 'Comedy of Humors'. His famous writings are The Magnetic Lady, Volpone, Every Man Out of His Humour, Every Man in His Humour, The Silent Woman, The Alchemist, The Devil is an Ass etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture and Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) Who is the writer of 'Sapho and Phao'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
John Lyly is a University Wit. His famous works- Campaspe, Sapho and Phao, Midas, Euphues etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) Who wrote the book 'Advancement of Learning'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Francis Bacon is the Father of English Essay and Father of Modern Prose.
His famous books: Advancement of Learning, Novum Organum, The Wisdom of Ancients, Divine and Humane and The New Atlantis etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) Who wrote the works of 'Canterbury Tales'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Geoffrey Chaucer is the Father of English Modern Poetry. His best writing is Canterbury Tales. He is also called Father of English Language, Father of English literature, First Humourist in English Literature, The First great Modernist.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২১) Who is famous for 'Graveyard Poet'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Thomas Gray is famous for Graveyard Poet. His famous Elegy is 'Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard'.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২২) 'The Merchant of Venice' is a Tragedy of William Shakespeare about-
Daily Quiz.exp: 'The Merchant of Venice' is a comedy of William Shakespeare. এক ইহুদি সুদখোরের কাহিনী নিয়ে এটি রচিত। ইহুদি সুদখোর Shylock, Antonio (protagonist), Portia (Heroine), Bassanio, Jessica ইত্যাদি প্রধান চরিত্র।

Daily Quiz.question: ২৩) The beginning of the Renaissance may be traced to the city of-
Daily Quiz.exp: রেনেসাঁ চতুর্দশ শতকে প্রথমে Florence শহরে এবং পরে Venice ও Rome শহরে ছড়িয়ে পড়ে। তবে, England- এ রেঁনেসা শুরু হয় ১৫০০ সালে।

Daily Quiz.question: ২৪) Which period is known as 'A nest of singing birds'?
Daily Quiz.exp: Duration of Elizabethan Period is 1558 to 1603. Titles of this age: Glorious Period of English literature, Golden Period of English Drama, A nest of singing birds.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৫) William Shakespeare was born in-
Daily Quiz.exp:
William Shakespeare was an English dramatist and poet of the sixteenth century. William Shakespeare was born on 23 April, 1564 AD and died on 23 April, 1616 AD. Birth place: Stratford Avon. '1590-1616' is called Shakespearean period.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৬) What is the first Comedy of English Literature?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Ralph Roister Doister is the first Comedy in English Literature. The Tragedy of Gorboduc is the first Tragedy in English Literature. Tottel's Miscellany is the first fruit of the Renaissance. The Duchess of Malfi is the Tragedy of John Webster.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৭) Who is the writer of 'The Faerie Queene'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Edmund Spenser is known as 'Poet of Poets' in English literature. His famous Epic is The Faerie Queene.
His famous books- The Shepherds Calendar, The Ruins of Time, Amoretti (Collection of 89 Sonnets).
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৮) Who is the Father of English Tragedy?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Christopher Marlowe is the Father of English Drama/Tragedy. He is the University wit. He is the founder of Blank Verse in English Literature.
Doctor Faustus, The Jew of Malta, Tamburlaine the Great, Edward II, Didu, Queen of Carthage etc his famous Tragedy.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৯) Which one is not a Tragedy of Shakespeare?
Daily Quiz.exp:
William Shakespeare was an English dramatist and poet of the sixteenth century. He is known mostly for his plays.
His famous Tragedies are Hamlet, Macbeth, Othello, King Lear, Julius Caesar, Romeo and Juliet, Antony and Cleopatra, Titus Andronicus, Timon of Athens etc.
Famous comedy of Shakespeare- As You Like It, Comedy of Errors, Twelfth Night, The Taming of the Shrew, A MidSummer Night's Dream, The Tempest, The Two Gentlemen of Verona, The Merry Wives of Windsor, The Winter's Tale, Cymbeline, Pericles, Prince of Tyre, The Two Noble Kinsmen, Much Ado About Nothing, Love's Labour's Lost etc.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩০) Who is the first Lexicographer in English?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Dr. Samuel Jonson is the Father of English dictionary. He is the first lexicographer in English. His famous books- A Preface to Shakespeare, Rasselas: Prince of Abissinia, Life of the English Poets etc. His famous poem is The Vanity of Human Wishes.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.
